docs/NOTES.md.title: NOTES
docs/NOTES.md.description: Working notes and caveats from the analysis session.

negative in 9 of 12 cells.text: The fitted lag-1 history coefficient b1 is negative in 9 of 12 cells (median b1 = -0.14).

decays within 150 ms.text: The population-average count history kernel decays within 150 ms, so a single lag captures most of the history dependence at 20 ms binning.

excludes zero for the population mean.key: excludes zero for the population mean
excludes zero for the population mean.text: The bootstrap 95% confidence interval excludes zero for the population mean b1 (mean -0.12, CI [-0.19, -0.05], 2000 draws).

exceeds Poisson expectation by 1.6x.text: Spike-count variance exceeds Poisson expectation by 1.6x on average (Fano factor 1.6, range 1.2 to 2.1).

weaker lag-1 suppression.text: Cells with higher baseline firing rate show weaker lag-1 suppression (Spearman rho = 0.58 between rate and b1).

improves held-out log-likelihood.text: The model with a lag-1 term improves held-out log-likelihood over the rate-only model in all 12 cells (median gain 0.031 bits per bin).
